description: WHAT: Legal doc router. doc enum: urheberrecht|copyright|impressum (maps text via discovery) or agb|nutzungsbedingungen|datenschutz|widerruf (www URL pointer only). Optional offset/limit for maps text. USE for citations. DOES NOT serve www legal HTML body on maps. NEXT: get_urheberrecht / get_impressum shortcuts; www for AGB body.

doc.description: Required. maps corpus: urheberrecht|copyright|impressum. www links only: agb|nutzungsbedingungen|datenschutz|widerruf.

limit.description: Maximum items or lines to return after offset. Omit = all remaining in the window (subject to tool-specific clamps). For geo near-search default is often 5 without radius_km, up to 52 with radius.

locale.description: maps is German-only (de). Omit or pass de. Other values are ignored; URLs stay https://maps.ikeytz.com/… with no locale prefix. Not a www multi-locale switch — use @ikeytz/mcp list_locales on www for en|fr|ru|fa|ar|tr.

offset.description: 0-based index into a list or discovery file lines (split on \n). 0 = first. Omit = 0. Combine with limit to page. Use nextOffset / offset+limit from a previous result when present.
